Quirk Interactions.text: When two Quirks meet, the result follows the physical effects involved, not a rule that one power cancels another. Fire meeting ice makes steam and meltwater; electricity runs through water and metal and finds whoever stands in them; wind feeds a fire or blows it back; a hardened body takes a blast that would break an ordinary one; a barrier holds until the force against it exceeds what it can bear. Two strong effects colliding can release far more than either alone, and the overflow lands on whoever is nearby, which is why fights between Quirk users are so destructive. Combinations can be deliberate. Teammates who know each other's Quirks build combined moves, a wind user carrying a flame user's heat or a water user soaking a target for an electric user, and hero academies drill pairs for exactly that. Unfamiliar Quirks meeting by accident are unpredictable, so pros on a joint operation share their Quirks' basics before the work starts. When two Quirks together cause an accident, both users answer for their own part.
